name: Set EEG reference
summary: Re-references epoched EEG data to the average reference, the REST infinity reference or chosen channels with MNE-Python set_eeg_reference.
description: Reads MNE epochs, calls epochs.set_eeg_reference with the chosen reference and saves the re-referenced epochs. Use it during EEG preprocessing when the recording reference is not the one wanted for analysis. REST needs channel positions (a montage) to compute the forward model.

parameters.description: Reference scheme: average of all EEG channels, REST (infinity reference) or a list of channel names.

options.label: infinity reference
options.description: Reference Electrode Standardization Technique infinity reference

options.label: empty
options.description: It will take a list from user input eventually

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).

failure_modes.fix: Set ref_ch to 'average', 'REST' or a list of channel names.
